comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA aims to purchase or generate enough renewable energy to match 100% of its global electricity usage for offices and data centers by the end of fiscal year 2025, having increased its matched renewable energy percentage to 44% in fiscal year 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA disclose specific renewable electricity targets and progress toward global energy matching. Intel's 2024 target was to reach 95% renewable electricity use globally, with compensation linkage. NVIDIA aims to match 100% of global electricity usage for offices and data centers by the end of fiscal year 2025, having reached 44% in fiscal year 2023. Both companies treat renewable energy goals as part of their environmental strategy in Item 1.

sentences.text: In 2024, continuing our practice of linking a portion of our executive and employee performance bonus to our corporate sustainability metrics, we linked a portion of the performance bonus to our 2024 target to reach 95% renewable electricity use globally.
By the end of fiscal year 2025, our goal is to purchase or generate enough renewable energy to match 100% of our global electricity usage for our offices and data centers.
In fiscal year 2023, we increased the percentage of our total electricity use matched by renewable energy purchases to 44%.

sentences.text: In 2024, continuing our practice of linking a portion of our executive and employee performance bonus to our corporate sustainability metrics, we linked a portion of the performance bonus to our 2024 target to reach 95% renewable electricity use globally.
The HR and Compensation Committee of our Board will consider human capital advancements in determining our executives' fiscal 2024 bonus.
For fiscal 2024, progress towards human capital advancements serves as a non-financial performance modifier that can adjust the executives' bonus payout by a multiple of 0.9 to 1.1.
